lines.text: Job says he is a laughingstock to his friends, while the tents of widows are safe.
Job says the animals, birds, earth and fish all know that the hand of the LORD has done this.
Job says wisdom and strength belong to God, who leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
Job desires to speak to the Almighty, and he says his friends are worthless shepherds whose wisdom would be silence.
Job says that though God slay him, he will hope in Him, and no godless man can appear before Him.
